Allocation of kerosene to NE States

SHARMAH: Will the Minister of

and consumption of kerosene in the North-
Eastern States, State-wise vis-a-vis the
national average; and
(b) the details of the steps taken or
proposed to be taken by Government to
increase the allocation of kerosene to
North-Eastern States?

SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:

COMPANY AFFAIRS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Unit Trust of India
(UTI) has been split into two parts namely
UTI-I and UTI-II;
(b) if so, the details and functions of
each of them; and
(c) what is the purpose of splitting it
into two parts?

Government have accepted the proposal
of disinvestment of Hindustan Petroleum
Corporation Ltd.(HPCL); and
(d) if so, the name of the agency
which would be entrusted with the
responsibility of completing the
construction of said refinery after the
disinvestment of HPCL?

the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the imported
equipments at Indira Gandhi International
Airport for making the runway operational
during fog conditions have failed to
function during fog in December, 2002

the Minister of FINANCE AND

absence of any State-sponsored Social-

Sector, Private Sector and self-employed
persons, incentive of tax-exemptions

PPF, NSC etc., and obtain self-financed
social-security;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
withdrawal of tax-exemptions will de-

aforesaid schemes jeopardising above said

sensitive issue?
Tourism project for Himachal Pradesh

Minister of TOURISM AND CULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of projects sanctioned
since 1998 for development of
infrastructure of Tourism in Himachal
Pradesh; and
(b) by when these projects are likely
to be completed?

the Minister of TOURISM AND
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that foreign
tourist traffic has come down during the
last three years ; if so, the details
thereof;
(b) whether Government have any hill
tourism policy keeping in view the
attraction of enchanting mountains in the
country;
(c) if not, what action is contemplated
to promote tourism, pilgrimage, adventure
and environmental aspects on mountains;
(d) what are the plans to develop Hill
Stations of India to attract more foreign
tourists; and
(e) the details of financial assistance
given to States during the last three years
for the development of tourism?
Demand of petroleum products
†*8. SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have assessed
the demand of petroleum products in the

Cauvery rivers
*9. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of WATER

crude oil on domestic prices

Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the fluctuations in the
prices of crude oil in the international
market during the last six months;
(b) in what manner these have
influenced the domestic prices of
petroleum products; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
increase domestic production of crude oil?

REDDY:
SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-

be completed;

if so, the details thereof;
(d) the cost estimated for the
completion of the project;
(e) whether Government would seek
foreign assistance for the project;
(f) whether Government's attention has

been made in this regard with the Ministry
of Defence?

SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
huge potential of attracting FDI in deep

————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Finance and Company Affairs; Petroleum
and Natural Gas; Tourism and Culture; Water Resources)
 Total number of questions—101

Non-privatisation of
airports
1. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA RAO:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided against privatisation of four
metro airports; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor?
Air service between Delhi and
Mangalore
2. SHRI JANARDHANA POOJARY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a proposal to
introduce either a direct or a hopping
flight on Delhi-Mangalore or Delhi-
Mumbai-Mangalore sector;
(b) if so, the present status of the
proposal; and
(c) if the reply to part (a) above be in
the negative, the reasons therefor?
FDI in aviation sector
3. SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMED
KHAN (DURRU):
DR. AKHILESH DAS:
Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
in August, 2002 to open the aviation
infrastructure to foreign direct investment;
(b) if so, the specific proposals cleared
in this regard;
(c) whether there was a proposal to
hand over the four metro airports to
lessors; and
(d) if so, the progress made in this
regard?
Expenditure on airport security
4. SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI BHAGATRAM MANHAR:
Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that expenditure
on airports' security in the country has
gone up by more than 25 per cent in the
past one year;
(b) if so, what are the details of the
amount spent on airports’ security by
various agencies namely Airports
Authority of India, and Central Industrial
Security Force, airport-wise; and
(c) what steps Government propose
to take to minimise the expenditure
on airports' security in the years to
come?

SIRIGIREDDY:

Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian
Airlines has sought permission from
Government to withdraw Services from
50 commercially unviable sectors;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that if the
proposal is implemented, the Indian
Airlines is likely to earn more profits;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:

AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
considering a proposal to float a joint

(AAI) with private corporates for all the
metro airports in the country; and

of the proposal?

(a) whether Government have decided
to set aside its proposal to privatise
Mumbai and Delhi airports and to have
direct investment for upgradation of these
airports;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have created
two separate groups/companies to oversee
the functioning of these airports; and
(d) if so, by when the groups are likely
to submit their reports and what are the
plans of Government for the upgradation
of these airports?

the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be

last one decade?

Hyderabad

location of new airport at Shamshabad;
and

AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to start a direct flight from
Kolkata to Moscow keeping in view the
traditional bonds of friendship between
India and Russia;
(b) if so, the details thereof and

assess the viability of the flights; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Rajkot-Delhi flight

the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be

(a) whether the proposal to start

(b) if so, by when it is likely to start;
and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?

the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the international and
domestic cargo handled by airports in the

October, 2001;
(b) if so, the quantum of this increase;
(c) whether new airports have done
better as compared to old airports; and
(d) if so, the steps taken to improve
infrastructural facilities in old airports?

Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased

Airlines are causing heavy losses to the

air tickets for national/international places
to their friends/nearer and dearer in the
name of public relations;

providing free air tickets to those people/

being paid rent;

put check on it; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Instrument Landing System (ILS) Cat-

in poor visibility?

(b) whether it is a fact that Indian
Airlines is seriously thinking of closing
down its offices in Europe;
(c) if so, the details of the offices
proposed to be closed down; and
(d) what are the reasons therefor?
Upgradation of Nagpur Airport

Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased

(a) whether it is a fact that the
State Government of Maharashtra has

Nagpur Airport; and

prepared;

been reviewed;

the Minister of FINANCE AND

SHRI LAJPAT RAI:

Government's revenue through direct and

SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:

prices of primary commodities like
kerosene, flour and vegetables have

identified three segments for the

steps to ensure that falling interest rate is

citizens; and

DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of FINANCE AND
COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:

Treasury Secretary, India was lagging
behind China in foreign direct investment
inflows due to poor governance and lack
of economic freedom;
(b) if so, whether India's strong
English language skills and democratic
system of Government should make it
preferable to US investors over a country
lacking both; and
(c) if so, what steps Government

our economy?

SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-

Commission was required to be put in
place in 2003 and its benefits made

(b) if so, whether action has been
initiated to appoint the 6th Pay
Commission; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
